fact: As of 19 September 2026 Gabon has enacted no general AI statute, but ordonnance n°0011/PR/2026 of 26 February 2026, published in Journal Officiel n°110 and in force since 8 April 2026, bans four categories of AI-generated deepfake content and requires visible marking of AI-generated content, enforced by the Haute Autorité de la Communication.
title: Gabon: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, product-liability, age-gating, and reuse law
